children: MATRIX SERVICE CO reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $873.63M, up 13.6% from $769.29M a year earlier, while narrowing its net loss to ($2.58M) and reporting diluted loss per share of ($0.09) — a meaningful improvement versus fiscal 2025 — according to its 10-K.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “Diluted loss per common share”.

Revenue growth was driven by the Storage & Terminal and Utility & Power segments, reflecting expansion into power generation, data-center power infrastructure, mining and LNG/NGL/ammonia storage projects.
Gross margin improved to 7.3% on stronger project execution, supporting better customer relationships and bidding success.
Management implemented a WIN/EXECUTE/DELIVER strategy, completed organizational restructuring that reduced SG&A, and appointed a new CEO.
Backlog stood at $953.2M, with approximately 79% expected to be recognized as revenue in fiscal 2027, providing near-term visibility into execution.
